schema_donor.usage: RBDSeries and RBDSeriesStructure table schema only; no donor business rows or results

source.rule: An assembly containing reliability blocks needs its own RBD; the assembly then participates as a block in the system RBD. Series and parallel RBD forms have distinct failure semantics.

configuration.physical: System TEACH-AIR-01 contains ASSY TEACH-ASSY-01, which contains POS-A/B/C; each position retains one TEACH-LRU-01. No ASSY failure or repair is configured.
configuration.system_rbd: G04-SYS-ROOT series RBD has one TEACH-ASSY-01 block in G04-OPS.
configuration.parallel_arm: ASSY mode points to active G04-ASSY-PARALLEL RBD, POS-A/B/C, NBREQ1, NBOP3, ONLM=N.
configuration.series_arm: ASSY mode points to G04-ASSY-SERIES RBD requiring all POS-A/B/C; unused parent parallel rows are empty.
configuration.failure_modes: Accepted parent: POS-A 300000 and POS-B 600000 per million OPHOURS; POS-C has no configured failure. BASE-01 half-hour direct CM remains unchanged.

exact_delta: Both arms insert the same physical ASSY, reparent the three positions, add an ASSY operational-mode row and a one-block system series RBD. Between arms only the ASSY RBID, owned RBD topology, and description differ. The mission, failures, repair, seed and report controls remain parent-identical.
pre_run_hypotheses: Both nested-RBD arms import, roundtrip, and calculate with zero conversion errors and only reviewed diagnostics.
The parallel arm retains noncritical first and second position failures and completes the h8–34 mission; the series arm makes the first position failure critical and aborts the mission.
The first failing position and time match across arms before their paths diverge. Native events and the 72-bin report reconcile.
native_acceptance: Two unique guarded session-0 SSH runs with queue, GUI identity, registry restoration, and frozen source/raw SHA-256 seals.
Both arms have exact populated-table roundtrip, zero conversion errors, reviewed warnings, and nonempty SXO/event log/report.
Matched first failure and distinct criticality/mission terminal state attributable to ASSY-owned RBD topology.
Independent read-only replay of sources, raw seals, events and reports separate from author implementation.
diagnostic_gate: Preserve any rejected or semantically divergent arm as a diagnostic; revise only under a new candidate version and run IDs. Do not infer nested-RBD semantics from source alone.
limits: One assembly, one operating mode, three positions, one seed and one replication; no general nesting or multi-assembly claim.
GUI RBD drawing and cross-engine equivalence remain unverified.
